{{Quote|I came armed with the larvae of creatures I stole from the labs of Sorzus Syn!|Remulus Dreypa|<ref name="Spiral 3">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 3|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''labs of Sorzus Syn''' were the laboratories where [[Sorzus Syn]] grew [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathan]] larvae. At some point, [[Remulus Dreypa]] broke into the labs and stole several larvae.<ref name="Spiral 3" />
